name: The Hog
long_description:
One API to search, enrich, and monitor the web.

An agent is only as good as the data it runs on. Most agents and GTM tools today are stuck pulling stale, fragmented data from a dozen different providers, which caps how good their output can ever be. We unify all of it behind one API.

One credit-based API covers people data, company data, web search, deep research, news, social signals, and web scraping. Multi-provider waterfall logic routes each call to the best source and falls back automatically, so you get one integration and one bill instead of stitching together Clay, Apollo, Exa, Tavily, and a handful of others.

We're building the data layer that agents and GTM teams plug into to find, understand, and reach their customers.
one_liner: Real-time web intelligence API for AI agents and GTM teams

launches.title: The Hog: AI Native Go-To-Market Command Center
launches.tagline: One person unlocks the power of entire sales and marketing teams
launches.body:
_“Ah, this is f\*\*\*\*\*\*\* good, dude. You really have done something here. I’m serious. Like look at the level of insight of this.”_ - David (from current customer; actual response will differ between users)

**TL;DR**

It’s like the Google Maps for customer acquisition: The Hog finds the most optimized ways to reach your customers. 

It gives one person the power of an entire sales and marketing team. It compresses research to execution from hours to minutes.

**Our Vision**

We believe the future of go-to-market is not dashboards. It is a command center where sales, marketing, and growth work together on the same platform with the same data.

Shared context creates faster decisions, cleaner execution, and fewer handoffs. This is how teams stay ahead and keep adaptive go-to-market playbooks dynamic, updating in real time as the market moves.

**The Hog: Promo Video**

https://youtu.be/jfcAEhqrJN0

**Why the ‘The Hog’?**

The Hog stands for Head of Growth (Hog), literally. It’s the dream tool our team wished we had when we scaled a startup from \~$900k ARR to $7M+ in 3 months as a solo growth hire, and helped pivot a company to profitability with only two months of runway left.

**What we built**

Our AI-native go-to-market command center, where you control an army of AI sales and marketing co-pilots to constantly monitor your market, identify opportunities, and generate actionable game plans to connect with your potential customers. 

Your customers engage outside of LinkedIn and Inboxes. The Hog continuously maps your ICP, channels, and opportunities, spots shifts in the market, and stack-ranks what to do next based on goals and constraints. 

**What can it do now?**

* Find where your ICPs spend time and how they behave across channels
* Generate tactical game plans with ranked next actions
* Market research and trend analysis
* Automated daily competitive and market monitoring
* Social listening for relevant topics and keywords across Reddit, LinkedIn, X, forums, and review sites
* Strategic messaging and positioning suggestions
* Create and manage company ‘Brand and Messaging Guide’
* Personal brand building
* SEO research plus blog and content drafts
* Digital marketing and PPC planning with keywords and budgets
* Auto-draft comments, posts, and replies for social engagement
* Thought leadership content for founder-led growth
* Brand awareness tracking and sentiment listening
* Channel strategies for Reddit, LinkedIn, and X
* Auto drafts for organic social and community engagement

**Why now?**

“The best product doesn't always win. The one everyone uses wins.” - Andrew Bosworth

AI has shortened the time to build new products and features, so companies must find traction faster. Standing out in a crowded market is harder and more important than ever. Startups need to reach real customers quickly to find PMF and scale, and they must do it beyond saturated channels like LinkedIn and email.

**Who is it for?**

* Anyone who needs a fractional Head of Growth or CMO co-pilot
* Teams looking to consolidate their marketing and sales tech stack
* Solo founders and lean teams that need to find PMF and traction faster
* Startups that want to meet customers where they actually are and engage with their communities
* Companies moving to a true multi-channel motion and looking for acquisition paths beyond paid ads
* Teams that want to grow brand awareness while automating founder-led content and engagement
